title: Photosynthesis
topic: Photosynthesis: what green plants need and what they produce

source.title: Photosynthesis – Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

excerpt.text: Photosynthesis is a process in which green plants make their own food from sunlight, using the help of leaves to produce sugar.
It is the process by which these organisms convert light energy into chemical energy, which is used to produce food.
Carbon dioxide enters the leaf through the stomata by diffusion from the atmosphere.
Water is absorbed from the soil by root hair cells, which have an increased surface area adapted for their uptake of water.
Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts in leaves (or other green tissues).
They contain chlorophyll, the green pigment that absorbs light energy.
In leaves, palisade cells have chloroplasts to capture light.
Oxygen is produced as a result of photosynthesis and released into the atmosphere through respiration.
All the oxygen in the atmosphere has its origin in plants (including those microorganisms which do photosynthesis).
Glucose is used in respiration (to release energy in cells).
It is stored in the form of starch (which is converted back to glucose for respiration in the dark).

s1.correct: make their own food from sunlight

variants.text: get their food from other organisms
variants.explanation: This contradicts the rest of the Variant: the next sentences say that the plants turn light energy into chemical energy to produce food. Original: "Photosynthesis is a process in which green plants make their own food from sunlight, using the help of leaves to produce sugar." Green plants make their own food, they do not get it from other organisms. A contradiction means that two sentences of one text cannot both be true.
variants.evidence: Photosynthesis is a process in which green plants make their own food from sunlight, using the help of leaves to produce sugar.

variants.text: make thier own food from sunlight
variants.explanation: The word is "their", with ei: t-h-e-i-r. Check the word letter by letter.
Original: "Photosynthesis is a process in which green plants make their own food from sunlight, using the help of leaves to produce sugar." The leaves help to produce sugar, not salt.
variants.evidence: Photosynthesis is a process in which green plants make their own food from sunlight, using the help of leaves to produce sugar.

variants.explanation: The word ends in -ar: sugar. Check the last syllable.
Original: "It is the process by which these organisms convert light energy into chemical energy, which is used to produce food." The light energy is converted into chemical energy, not into heat.
variants.evidence: It is the process by which these organisms convert light energy into chemical energy, which is used to produce food.

variants.explanation: The word ends in -al: chemical. Check the ending.

variants.text: Since green plants can make their own food, every living thing can do the same.
variants.explanation: This sentence is not in the Original. The Original only says that green plants make their own food. Here a conclusion is drawn from one group to every living thing. This is overgeneralisation: from some cases to all.
Original: "Carbon dioxide enters the leaf through the stomata by diffusion from the atmosphere." The carbon dioxide comes from the atmosphere. It is the water that is absorbed from the soil.
variants.evidence: Carbon dioxide enters the leaf through the stomata by diffusion from the atmosphere.

variants.explanation: The word is spelt with ph: "atmosphere", as in "sphere". Check the second half of the word.

Original: "Water is absorbed from the soil by root hair cells, which have an increased surface area adapted for their uptake of water." The water is absorbed by root hair cells. Palisade cells are in the leaves and have chloroplasts to capture light.
variants.evidence: Water is absorbed from the soil by root hair cells, which have an increased surface area adapted for their uptake of water.

variants.explanation: "Hare" is a real word, but it is an animal. The cells are called root hair cells, with hair as in the hair on your head.

Original: "Water is absorbed from the soil by root hair cells, which have an increased surface area adapted for their uptake of water." The water is absorbed from the soil by root hair cells, not by leaf cells.
variants.evidence: Water is absorbed from the soil by root hair cells, which have an increased surface area adapted for their uptake of water.

variants.text: A large tree can take up several hundred litres of water in a single day.
variants.explanation: This sentence is not in the Original. The Original says how the water is absorbed, but it gives no amount of water and says nothing about trees.
Original: "Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts in leaves (or other green tissues)." Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts, not in the mitochondria.
variants.evidence: Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts in leaves (or other green tissues).

variants.explanation: The word begins with chl-, as in chlorophyll: chloroplasts.
Original: "They contain chlorophyll, the green pigment that absorbs light energy." Chlorophyll absorbs light energy, it does not produce it.
variants.evidence: They contain chlorophyll, the green pigment that absorbs light energy.

variants.explanation: After "that" the verb ends in -s: "absorbs". The ending -es does not fit this word.

Original: "In leaves, palisade cells have chloroplasts to capture light." The chloroplasts are there to capture light. "Although" turns the purpose into a contrast, and the sentence no longer makes sense.
variants.evidence: In leaves, palisade cells have chloroplasts to capture light.

variants.explanation: Original: "Oxygen is produced as a result of photosynthesis and released into the atmosphere through respiration." Oxygen is produced. Carbon dioxide is what the plant takes in.
variants.evidence: Oxygen is produced as a result of photosynthesis and released into the atmosphere through respiration.

variants.explanation: The word is spelt with y: "oxygen". Check the second syllable.

Original: "All the oxygen in the atmosphere has its origin in plants (including those microorganisms which do photosynthesis)." The Original says "all" the oxygen. "Most of" weakens the claim and makes a different statement.
variants.evidence: All the oxygen in the atmosphere has its origin in plants (including those microorganisms which do photosynthesis).

variants.explanation: Original: "All the oxygen in the atmosphere has its origin in plants (including those microorganisms which do photosynthesis)." The Original says "all" the oxygen has its origin in plants, not "nearly all".
variants.evidence: All the oxygen in the atmosphere has its origin in plants (including those microorganisms which do photosynthesis).

variants.text: Photosynthesis is without doubt the most beautiful process in nature.
variants.explanation: This sentence is not in the Original. "The most beautiful" is an opinion, not a fact. Here a judgement is presented as if it were a fact.
Original: "Glucose is used in respiration (to release energy in cells)." In respiration the glucose is used to release energy, not to store it.
variants.evidence: Glucose is used in respiration (to release energy in cells).

variants.explanation: A letter is missing: the verb is "releases", with two e's in the first two syllables.
Original: "It is stored in the form of starch (which is converted back to glucose for respiration in the dark)." The starch is converted back to glucose for respiration in the dark, not in the light.
variants.evidence: It is stored in the form of starch (which is converted back to glucose for respiration in the dark).

variants.explanation: Original: "It is stored in the form of starch (which is converted back to glucose for respiration in the dark)." The Original says the starch is converted back "in the dark". "All the time" changes when this happens.
variants.evidence: It is stored in the form of starch (which is converted back to glucose for respiration in the dark).

variants.text: Because glucose is stored as starch, plants can live for years without any light.
variants.explanation: This sentence is not in the Original. It draws a conclusion the text does not support: a store of starch does not mean that a plant survives for years in the dark. This is a faulty inference: a "because" links two things that the text does not link.

notes: Source read: Simple English Wikipedia article "Photosynthesis", revision 10903963 (retrieved 18.10.2026, saved text of the whole article; references, tables and boxes left out). The eleven excerpt sentences stand verbatim in the saved article text and in the source's order (checked by script, as were all evidence quotes and the evidence of the variants). Left out: the third sentence of the lead (it names glucose and starch), the chemical equation, and everything from "Origin" on except the stretch "Ways it is done", and the sections on phases, factors, evolution and effectiveness. Pronouns "These organisms" and "They" in the excerpt refer to the plants and chloroplasts named before them.

Error types: the misspellings (thier, suger, chemicle, atmosfere, cloroplasts, absorbes, oxigen, relases) and the real-word variant (root hare cells) are constructed on typical patterns, not taken from learner data; the classes from grade 7 (quantity or degree, overgeneralisation, faulty inference, opinion as fact) are derived, not documented. The sentences s4, s7, s13 and s16 are insertions that the Original does not contain.

Not verified: whether the article is right in biology. The pack checks the comparison with this source, not the science. The source says oxygen is "released into the atmosphere through respiration" and the Variant keeps that wording as it stands. The claim about a large tree (s7) is invented and not checked against any source; it only has to be absent from the Original.
